stemMd: A collection has 5 distinct reports. Two are chosen at random without replacement. How many unordered pairs are possible?
explanationMd: Choose two of five: 5(4)/2=10. Division by 2 removes the duplicate orderings of each pair.

distractorRationale.d: Allows selecting the same report twice.
distractorRationale.a: Counts individual reports rather than pairs.
